tests.note_pg_shard_headroom: Even healthy, the pg shard takes 523s against a 600s meson timeout on this box. A slower machine may need the timeout raised rather than assuming a real hang.

deviations_from_expectation.finding: PostgreSQL test role needs pg_signal_backend, not just CREATEDB
deviations_from_expectation.severity: high — cost a 600s timeout and leaked 70 databases before diagnosis
deviations_from_expectation.detail: PostgresTestDb drops each ephemeral database WITH (FORCE), which terminates attached backends; that requires pg_signal_backend membership. Without it every test leaks its database, silently, until the pg shard times out.
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: GRANT added to setup-rhel9.sh --with-postgres; --check verifies both the membership and that no yuzu_test_* databases have leaked; documented as trap 4 with a cleanup snippet.

deviations_from_expectation.severity: medium — breaks one meson test and the /test skill's telemetry DB
deviations_from_expectation.detail: System python3's sqlite3 module links sqlite-libs 3.34.1. python3.11/3.12 from AppStream do not help — they depend on the same sqlite-libs. C++ is unaffected (vcpkg SQLite 3.52.0).
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: Documented as a known limitation; not resolvable by the setup script.

deviations_from_expectation.finding: ccache is EPEL-only on the RHEL 9 family
deviations_from_expectation.detail: In neither BaseOS, AppStream nor CRB — verified by repoquery with EPEL disabled. ninja-build IS in CRB, which is easy to conflate.
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: ccache made optional; --with-epel added; the generated env file selects 'ccache gcc' or plain 'gcc' at source-time.

deviations_from_expectation.finding: meson warns that 1.12.0 will require Python 3.10+
deviations_from_expectation.detail: RHEL 9's default python3 is 3.9 (EOL). Works with the pinned meson 1.11.2.
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: Documented, including the trap that PyYAML must be importable by whichever python3 meson resolves.

deviations_from_expectation.finding: setup.sh's link-tests.sh call links nothing on a fresh checkout
deviations_from_expectation.detail: It runs at configure time, before the test binaries exist.
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: Run 'bash scripts/link-tests.sh' once after the first compile; documented.

deviations_from_expectation.finding: Cold vcpkg build was much faster than the repo's ~65-70 min estimate
deviations_from_expectation.detail: 20.3 min for all 22 ports on 16 cores, grpc alone 13 min.
deviations_from_expectation.resolution: Recorded so the estimate can be calibrated per core count.
